insights.one_liner: MSD Netherlands is the Haarlem-based Dutch arm of Merck & Co., making medicines and vaccines for people and animals; two finance roles here need no Dutch.

culture.text: About 1,250 people on LinkedIn, mostly in operations, research, sales and quality, often with biology, chemistry, biotech or business backgrounds.
It calls itself the largest and most varied medicines company in the Netherlands.
Both its open jobs here are mid and senior finance and accounting roles in Haarlem, averaging 78 LinkedIn applicants.

open.text: No MSD entity appears on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Both current jobs need no Dutch, and one of the two mentions visa or relocation.

growth.text: Its Phase IIb study of the drug tulisokibart met its main goal.

worth_knowing.text: Its ultimate owner is US-based Merck & Co.
MSD and Daiichi Sankyo withdrew the filing for their lung cancer candidate I-DXd.
